name: tradingview-youtube-edit
description: Premium TradingView strategy showcase built with Remotion.

scripts.render:reel: npm run generate:reel-voice && remotion render src/index.ts TradingStrategyReel out/final/trading-strategy-reel.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:wealth: npm run generate:wealth-voice && npm run generate:wealth-stills && npm run generate:wealth-bed && remotion render src/index.ts WealthEquationDocumentary out/final/wealth-equation-documentary.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:stock-market-dark: npm run generate:stock-market-dark-voice && npm run generate:stock-market-dark-bed && remotion render src/index.ts StockMarketDarkDocumentary out/final/stock-market-dark-documentary.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=14 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.render:stock-market-english: npm run generate:stock-market-english-voice && npm run generate:stock-market-english-bed && remotion render src/index.ts StockMarketEnglish150Documentary out/final/stock-market-english-documentary.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=14 --pixel-format=yuv420p
